fusions.name: Bobbing Decoys
fusions.desc: Skims 3 decoys out on lines at once, spread apart. Each decoy deals 3 damage, with a 20% chance to turn its target against its allies for 2.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dabbler's Hook
fusions.desc: Hooks the first enemy it meets on a float line and dunks it. It deals 11 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Backwash
fusions.desc: For 7 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to pass back to whoever laid it instead.

fusions.name: Little Ones in Tow
fusions.desc: A bonded hatchling follows you on a strand, pecking enemies within 3 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.
